anchors.flow_staining_volume: 10 µL of microbeads were added to 1 mL
anchors.negative_threshold: Plates yielding <10 CFU/mL were interpreted as negative

anchors.plating_volume: 1 µL of each DTT-treated and untreated suspension

anchors.raw_supplement_exists: Raw paired FACS and culture data used for all statistical analyses are provided in Data set S1
anchors.resuspension_volume: pellet was resuspended in 1 mL of 0.1% DTT solution
anchors.species_identity_limit: species-level identification was not systematically performed
anchors.zero_log_handling: For culture-negative samples (CFU = 0), a constant value of 1 CFU was added
